summary: Quantum eMotion Corp filed a Form 6-K containing its quarterly MD&A and interim financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The filing notes the appointment of Jason Thomas as Director of Product Development of its subsidiary QeMA effective April 1, 2026, but this is a routine management change in the ordinary course of business and not a forced or abrupt departure. No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or strategic review is disclosed. The filing is a periodic report by a foreign private issuer regarding its financial results and operational updates.
